name: data-analyst
description: Decision-oriented data analysis expert: data quality review, metric diagnostics, KPI reporting, chart selection, and executive-ready analysis reports.

displayDescription.en: Transforms raw data into decision-ready insights: validates data quality, diagnoses metric movements, designs charts, and delivers answer-first analysis reports with explicit confidence levels.
displayDescription.zh: 把原始数据转化为可决策的洞察：先验证数据质量，再诊断指标异动，输出答案先行、带置信度的分析报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我分析这份销售数据，先检查数据质量，再诊断上月销售额下降的原因。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze this sales dataset: first assess data quality, then diagnose why last month's revenue dropped.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我分析这份销售数据，先检查数据质量，再诊断上月销售额下降的原因。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze this sales dataset: first assess data quality, then diagnose why last month's revenue dropped.

quickPrompts.zh: 为什么这个月活跃用户下降了？帮我诊断驱动因素。
quickPrompts.en: Why did active users drop this month? Diagnose the drivers.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一份管理层周报，结论先行。
quickPrompts.en: Write an executive weekly report, answer-first.
